9mothers-9-mothers:ashbyhq:9fbbd391-4194.title: Electronics & Hardware Buyer/Purchaser, Senior
9mothers-9-mothers:ashbyhq:9fbbd391-4194.description: Location: Onsite — Austin, TX Employment Type: Direct Hire, Full Time Job Title: Senior Buyer/Purchaser About 9 Mothers The modern battlefield has changed. Cheap, autonomous suicide drones have turned the tactical advantage upside down, and the world is looking for a solution. At 9 Mothers, we aren’t just "innovating"—we are building the shield. Backed by top-tier investors, we develop AI powered machines designed to intercept and neutralize Group 1/sUAS threats in real-time. Our flagship product is a low-power, counter-drone system built for the edge—on vehicles, at bases, or in a soldier's pack. Why 9 Mothers? While others build for "awareness" or "long-term research," we build for the immediate survival of those in harm’s way. We are a team of hackers, engineers, and mission-driven builders who value field-ready capability over polished slide decks. If you want to see your code or hardware in the field next month—not next year—this is your playground. Position Summary 9 Mothers builds counter-UAS systems — robotic shotgun turret platforms and a proprietary belt-fed shotgun system. Everything we ship starts with parts: custom electronics, machined metal, actuators, cables, and cameras, sourced from vendors we trust. Today, engineers buy their own parts. That stops working the moment we move from prototype and small-run quantities into production — which is exactly where we are headed over the next 12 months. You will be our first dedicated buyer and, initially, a department of one. You will own procurement end to end: finding parts, qualifying vendors, negotiating, placing and chasing POs, and building the purchasing processes and systems this company will scale on. As we grow into production, this role grows with the company — the person who defines purchasing here has a clear path to leading the function. Two things make this role harder than a typical buyer seat. First, we run on scarce, allocated electronics — NVIDIA Jetson modules, cameras, specialty sensors — and you need to be the person who can find them when distributors say twelve months. Second, we are a defense company: our supply base must exclude Chinese vendors, with a strong preference for US suppliers, and you own keeping it that way. Essential Duties Sourcing & Procurement (Primary) - Source and purchase the full robotics bill of materials: custom electronics and PCB assemblies, CNC-machined metal parts, actuators and motors, cable assemblies, cameras and sensors, and supporting COTS hardware - Hunt down hard-to-find and allocated electronics — NVIDIA Jetson modules, GPUs, image sensors — through authorized distribution, direct manufacturer relationships, and carefully vetted secondary-market channels, managing counterfeit risk and allocation constraints - Run the quote-to-PO cycle: solicit and compare quotes, negotiate pricing, payment terms, and lead times, place purchase orders, and track and expedite deliveries against build schedules - Own vendor selection within our trade-compliance constraints: build and maintain a non-Chinese supply base with a strong preference for US vendors, verifying country of origin down to the component level where required Building the Purchasing Function - Define the company's purchasing processes from scratch: PO workflow and approvals, vendor onboarding and qualification, receiving and inspection handoff, and spend tracking - Select and stand up purchasing tooling — from spreadsheets that actually work today to an ERP/MRP system that supports production volumes - Build and maintain the approved vendor list; work with engineering on part numbering, BOM hygiene, and approved alternates - Give the company visibility: report on spend, open orders, lead-time risk, and cost trends so engineering and leadership can plan around reality Scaling to Production - Transition the supply base from prototype and small-run buys to production purchasing: qualify vendors for volume, establish second sources for critical parts, and negotiate

jobgether-jobgether:lever:8e9af2e0-45b8-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. As a Technical Account Manager, you will serve as a strategic and technical partner to large enterprise customers throughout their entire journey. You will guide customers from onboarding and implementation through long-term adoption, retention, and expansion. The role combines technical expertise, project management, customer success, and consultative problem-solving. Your curiosity and ability to understand complex data environments will help customers get the most from a sophisticated technology platform. You will also bring customer feedback and emerging use cases back to internal teams to influence product evolution. This is an opportunity to make a direct impact in a fast-moving, collaborative, and technology-driven environment. Own the technical customer journey from kickoff and onboarding through ongoing success, adoption, retention, and expansion. Manage and execute customer-facing technical projects, ensuring onboarding activities are well organized, timely, and aligned with customer objectives. Build strong relationships with enterprise customers and develop a deep understanding of their business requirements, technical environments, use cases, and challenges. Provide proactive technical guidance and recommend best practices to help customers maximize the value and adoption of the platform. Partner closely with Sales and Customer Success teams to identify opportunities to increase platform adoption and support the growth of strategic accounts. Collaborate with Customer Support, Engineering, and other internal teams to investigate and resolve complex technical issues and escalations. Translate customer requirements into practical, efficient solutions while helping customers navigate complex technical systems. Identify emerging customer use cases, recurring challenges, and product opportunities, and communicate these insights to Engineering and other product teams. Serve as a trusted advisor who can balance technical depth with business priorities and customer outcomes. Manage competing priorities, deadlines, and unexpected roadblocks while maintaining a high standard of customer service. Requirements: 5+ years of experience in a client-facing and/or technology-focused role combining strong business understanding with technical expertise. Demonstrated experience managing and delivering technical projects with a customer-first mindset and strong empathy for customer needs. Excellent project management, organization, written communication, and verbal communication skills. Strong ability to quickly learn new technologies and understand complex technical environments, including SQL, databases, APIs, reporting tools, and related systems. Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving abilities, with a genuine interest in continuously developing technical expertise. Ability to understand customer requirements at a detailed level and translate complex technical concepts into clear, practical recommendations. Proven ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders with different technical backgrounds and responsibilities. Ability to remain composed and effective under pressure, manage deadlines, and navigate unexpected challenges with confidence. A customer-oriented, curious, proactive, and consultative approach, with the ability to build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders. Willingness and ability to work in a fast-paced technology environment where priorities can evolve quickly. Benefits: Competitive compensation package. Meaningful equity compensation through ISO options. Early exercise opportunities for eligible equity. 10-year post-termination exercise window for equity op
